description: Locate where a described feature likely lives in an already-extracted JS/Electron app, using deterministic lexical and structural scoring (not semantic/LLM matching, so results stay explainable). Returns ranked matches with file, line range, a short snippet, and a score, every snippet AIDefence-screened before return. Use when the target app is too large to read file-by-file and you need evidence of where a feature lives before explaining or reimplementing it — grep is fine for an exact known string, but wrong when you only have a plain-language description of the behavior.

path.description: Absolute path to a directory of extracted JS/Electron source

query.description: Plain-language description of the feature to locate

name: rure_find_feature
